title: Irish Potato Stew
description: A hearty and comforting Irish stew made with potatoes, stewing beef and vegetables.
instructions: Heat oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Brown the stewing beef in batches until browned on all sides.
Remove the browned beef from the pot and set aside.
Add the chopped onion and cook until softened.
Add the chopped celery and cook for 2 minutes.
Add the potatoes and carrots, and cook for 5 minutes.
Add the browned beef back into the pot.
Pour in enough beef broth to cover the ingredients.
Bring the stew to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 1 hour.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
